title: Integrated observability provisioning for Private installs (Prometheus/Grafana, Fluent Bit, Alerting)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds automated provisioning and upgrade paths for an opinionated observability stack in Private deployments. Motivation: private customers repeatedly request a reproducible, secure observability bundle (Prometheus + Alertmanager, Grafana with preloaded dashboards, and Fluent Bit log shipping) that can be toggled during installer runs and upgraded/rolled back reliably. This PR implements: (1) a new Helm umbrella chart 'redwood-observability-private' that installs Prometheus Operator service monitors, Alertmanager with routing rules, Grafana provisioning (dashboards + datasources), and Fluent Bit DaemonSet with pluggable outputs (S3/Elasticsearch/HTTP). Charts respect podSecurityContext and run-as-user constraints for hardened clusters; values allow disabling any subchart. (2) A Terraform module 'monitoring/monitoring-network' that seeds required infra for on-prem/VPC installs: optional VPC peering resources, S3 buckets (for log archive), IAM roles/policies for pushers when cloud endpoints are used, and a managed Alertmanager webhook endpoint. Module is idempotent and supports plan-only runs during dry-run install. (3) Installer CLI flags and config schema changes: --enable-observability, observability.mode (managed/local), observability.outputs (s3,elastic,none), and rollout.strategy. (4) Safe upgrade and rollback toolkit: helm pre-upgrade hooks snapshot Prometheus PVCs, Terraform state locking integrated via remote backend, and a new installer subcommand 'redwood-installer observability rollback --to-revision N' that coordinates helm rollback plus terraform state revert. (5) Observability CI: unit tests for Helm chart templating, an integration harness that boots a 3-node private cluster in CI's k8s-in-docker job and validates serviceMonitor metrics and a sample Grafana dashboard render. Compatibility notes: default installation is opt-in; existing private installs are unaffected unless operator flips flag. Secrets: S3/Elastic credentials are injected via the existing installer secrets mechanism and never stored in chart values; RBAC manifests are minimal and documented. Checklist: manual review of dashboards; docs for operators; e2e smoke pass; alert routing reviewed with SRE. Known limitations: fluent bit output plugins require customer's endpoint to accept lines in the configured format; large-scale Prometheus retention must be tuned per-customer. See files_changed for code pointers and the review thread for decisions.

release_notes: Added opt-in observability bundle for Private installs: helm umbrella chart (Prometheus/Grafana/Fluent Bit), Terraform module for infra dependencies, installer CLI flags to enable/disable, and safe upgrade/rollback tooling; RBAC and secrets handling hardened; documentation and example configs included.
summary: Automates provisioning and lifecycle (install/upgrade/rollback) of an opinionated observability stack for Private deployments, with Terraform infra module and Helm umbrella chart; opt-in and backwards compatible.
testing_notes: Unit helm template tests pass; integration e2e smoke runs in k8s-in-docker succeeded after retry fixes; manual validation performed against a customer-like VPC on prem environment; added CI job to run smoke on protected branch.
operator_instructions: To enable observability during install: add observability.enabled: true and observability.mode: local|managed to your config, or run 'redwood-installer apply --enable-observability --tf-backend <backend>'. To rollback: 'redwood-installer observability rollback --to-revision <rev>' which coordinates helm rollback and terraform state revert.
known_limitations: Prometheus retention defaults are conservative; for high-cardinality workloads customers must tune retention and remote-write. Fluent Bit has limited built-in parsers; customers with custom syslog formats should supply custom filter configs.
changelog_highlights:
- New Helm umbrella chart 'redwood-observability-private'
- Terraform module for monitoring infra
- Installer CLI flags and rollback command
- Preloaded Grafana dashboards and provisioning templates
notes_for_support: Support teams: when customers report missing metrics, check serviceMonitor selection labels and namespace scoping; for logs, verify fluent-bit output configuration and S3 policy permissions. Use the included troubleshooting section in docs/private/observability.md.
